text:
Mateo Ruiz: Heads-up — planning a config-only rollout to change autoscaler bounds for dedicated-gpu-slice-3. Target window 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC. This is non-incident but we want a short canary + smoke. Who can own deploy, smoke, and rollback?
Priya Iyer: I can own deploy + monitor for the first 30m. Will be available in the window.
Alice Chen: I can run the smoke checklist and handle rollback if needed. Ping me 10m before cut.
Jamie Park: I can standby for metrics and infra logs. I'll set up dashboards and alert thresholds now.
Mateo Ruiz: Thanks. Plan: 1) push autoscaler params change to slice-3 as canary 10% traffic for 10m 2) if good, ramp to 100% over 15m 3) verify latency/cost signals and pod stability. Autoscaler change is: min_replicas 2 -> 4, max_replicas 20 -> 30, burst_threshold 0.7 -> 0.55.
Alice Chen: What CLI command will you use for the config patch?
Mateo Ruiz: Using infractl v2: 
```
infractl patch-slice --slice dedicated-gpu-slice-3 --set autoscaler.min=4 --set autoscaler.max=30 --set autoscaler.burst_threshold=0.55 --canary 10%
```
Mateo Ruiz: Rollback command (prepped):
```
infractl rollback-slice --slice dedicated-gpu-slice-3 --to-tag autoscaler-v1
```
Larry Singh: Oncall availability: I'll be reachable via phone for 60m after deploy. If alerts fire, prioritize rollback and set routing to slice-2.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for dedicated-gpu-slice-3 at 2026-04-02T22:00:00Z by @Mateo Ruiz. Canary: 10%.
Priya Iyer: Smoke checklist (quick):
- confirm canary 10% applied (infractl status-slice)
- run 5 concurrent gen requests to slice-3 via smoke harness: `./smoke/smoke_gen.py --slice slice-3 --parallel 5 --iters 20`
- check Redwood Console latency p99 < 150ms, error rate < 0.5%
- verify GPU memory normal, no OOMs in pod logs
- confirm autoscaler upscales within 3m under load test
Alice Chen: I'll run the harness and paste results. If p99 > 200ms or errors > 1% I will call rollback.
Jamie Park: I'm adding an adhoc graph for token/sec and p99 and a log filter for OOM|OOMKilled. Alert thresholds: p99 > 200ms OR error_rate > 1% -> page Larry.
Mateo Ruiz: Small extra safety: setting fallback routing policy to prefer slice-2 if canary fails. Also we keep previous autoscaler policy snapshot tag: autoscaler-v1 saved.
Alice Chen: Running the harness now in staging to validate commands, will report back with exact CLI output before the window.
infra-bot: Canary config snapshot created: snapshot-2423456789-autoscaler. Linked to runbook: https://console.redwood/slices/slice-3/runbook
Priya Iyer: Last check — who will press the final ramp? Mateo?
Mateo Ruiz: I'll do the ramp from 10% -> 100% if the smoke passes at 10m. Ramp command: `infractl set-canary --slice slice-3 --percent 100 --reason "autoscaler-bounds-rollout"`
Larry Singh: Acknowledged. I'm on-call and will authorize rollback if alerts trigger.
Alice Chen: Smoke run on staging looked clean, sending exemple output: `success: 100/100 requests, p99=120ms, errors=0`. I'll re-run against canary during window and paste results.
Priya Iyer: OK. I'll start a dedicated Slack thread at T-10m to coordinate final go/no-go and post the infractl status.
Mateo Ruiz: Great. Thanks everyone — we'll follow this plan and keep the channel updated.
deploy-bot: Deploy completed (canary 10%) at 2026-04-02T22:00:30Z for dedicated-gpu-slice-3.
Alice Chen: Canary smoke (10%) run results: `requests=200, p99=135ms, errors=0, no OOMs`. Proceeding to ramp in 2m unless objections.
Jamie Park: No objections, metrics look normal on dashboards.
Mateo Ruiz: Ramping to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 100% initiated at 2026-04-02T22:12:10Z by @Mateo Ruiz.
Priya Iyer: Full smoke after ramp: `requests=500, p99=140ms, errors=1 (0.2%), autoscaler scaled to 6 pods under load`. All good.
Larry Singh: No noisy alerts. Closing loop: rollout successful, snapshot saved as autoscaler-v2. If anything pops up, we have rollback steps and snapshot tag ready. :tada:
